knobs.note: BH-6335: the repo whose Harness CI (harness-ci.yml) failed merge-queue batch runs are read, one local record per run in state/prequeue-learned/runs/. Only cromford runs that workflow. NOT settable from the control plane: it is an identity the lane reads GitHub as, so only env/global.env on the box moves it.

BH-6335: a suite goes on the learned list (the pre-queue gate's `learned` input) only when this many distinct failed merge-queue batches named it inside PREQUEUE_LEARNED_DAYS. Read by bin/prequeue-learned.sh --list.
BH-6335: the window. --list counts the records of batch runs created in the last this-many days; --refresh reads the runs created in the same window. Records are kept 30 days whatever this says.
BH-6335: at most this many suites on the learned list, highest counts first, ties by name. Bounds the time the learned suites add to every pre-queue gate run.
BH-6335: at most this many 100-run pages of the harness-ci.yml run list per --refresh tick.

BH-6335: at most this many unrecorded failed batch runs have their logs read per tick (the log and one jobs page each, through bin/lib/flaky.sh). The rest are logged as deferred and drain oldest first on later ticks.
